out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the rear of the kitchen , near the three compartment sink being used to store plastic containers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed the plastic containers from the handwashing sink.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Dishwashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of 0ppm chlorine. The dish-ware is not properly sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC discontinued use the dish machine and set up 3 compartment sink for properly sanitizing dish-ware. PIC properly sanitized the dish-ware.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MARINARA SAUCE IN STEAM TABLE AT 132F. FOOD WORKER CONFIRMED IT WAS PLACED IN HOT HOLDING FIVE HOURS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: MARINARA DISPOSED OF AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MOZZARELLA AT 45F (1HR), COOKED PASTA AT 46F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: FOODS MOVED TO OTHER COOLER. DO NOT USE THIS COOLER TO STORE ANY TCS FOODS UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED TO HOLD FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD PRODUCTS. OBSERVED FOODS BEING STORED IN GARLIC CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE REPLACE THESE GARLIC CONTAINERS WITH NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS OR THE EQUIVALENT FOR THE STORAGE OF FOOD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: (1) TWO DOOR PREP-TOP COOLER WAS AT 43F AND HOLDING FOOD 45F-46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PAISANO'S PIZZA (Inspection Date: 08/27/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located by the dish machine is blocked by a ladder preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.PIC MOVED THE LADDER.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: observed pizza sauce marked with an incorrect time label
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC CORRECTED LABEL.
